title: AMT workflow definition
description: Contract for every business, operations and engineering workflow (11_Production_Contracts/WORKFLOW_CONTRACT.md §2). Runtime computes definition_digest = sha256(canonical JSON of this document) at publish; runs pin workflow_id + definition_version + definition_digest.

definition_version.description: Monotonic revision of this definition. A new value never changes runs that already pinned an older one.

purpose.description: Business or operational outcome this workflow is accountable for.

source_refs.description: Registry ids behind trigger.source: service_id, agent, human role or alias, external participant, workflow id, operations.yaml#schedule id, signal kind, timer id, or a <config>.yaml#<path> reference (validator W08)

dedup_key.description: Expression over trigger input; duplicate trigger with an open run attaches to it

schedules_by_key.description: Cron per input key (Asia/Tashkent) when one definition serves several scheduled keys; `schedule` stays the primary key's cron

signals_by_key.description: Signal kind per input key when a definition starts a run on a signal (workflow-policy.yaml#signals.catalog; validator W10)

signal_windows.description: Per key: when a signal may start a run and what a late signal does

optional_fields.description: Fields that may be absent at start; failure_paths.missing_input states what the run does without them

freshness.description: Readiness keys whose runtime freshness rule (snapshot TTL, data cutoff, valid_until) must hold at start AND again before any external effect; this is not the key's own max_evidence_age, which is checked at signing and at the profile gate

max_duration.description: ISO-8601 duration, or readiness:<key> when the bound is a business value still to be approved

max_minor_ref.description: Per-run cap held in a readiness value (budget.request_bounds run_caps_minor per workflow; engineering.budget per_proposal_max_minor): required with max_minor null whenever the definition has an agent step (workflow-policy.yaml#cost_caps; validator M09)

extra_bound_refs.description: Other bounds on what the run may consume or cause (media jobs: budget.media; experiment ad exposure: business.exposure); they never replace the per-run LLM cap

cost.description: budget_account is where the run's LLM and media requests are charged (ai_runtime for a definition with a runtime agent step, engineering for engineering roles); ads spend caused by its commands is bounded per command by budgets.yaml ads, not by this run cap

on_limit.description: What a trigger does while a limit is reached (workflow-policy.yaml#concurrency_semantics); absent means on_limit_default

key.description: Trigger key (trigger.schedules_by_key) this escalation applies to; absent means every key

end_steps.description: Steps whose outputs no later step consumes (the run's end events); every other step feeds a later step (validator W16)

executor.description: Who performs the step. deterministic: a runtime-isolation.yaml#services service_id or a workflow-policy.yaml#external_participants entry with executes_steps: true; agent: a runtime-isolation.yaml agents or engineering_roles id; human: a role (roles.yaml roles or responsibility_assignments) or a workflow-policy.yaml#human_aliases name (validator W08)

requires_flag.description: roles.yaml#flags flag the performing person must hold (human executors only; required when the alias says flag: from_executor)

when.description: Condition on an upstream step's named output. When it is false the step is recorded skipped with reason condition_false and its dependants continue; it is never retried (validator W15). `any_of` opens the step when at least one condition holds; a step that collects `acks` must list a `handback_triggers` condition, so a handback-only incident never skips it (FR-GOV-10, ✅ Q31)

output_fields.description: Named, machine-readable fields of this step's result that a later step's `when` may test (validator W15)

schedule_refs.description: operations.yaml#schedule ids whose slot this step follows although the slot does not start the run (validator T11, two-way with workflow-policy.yaml#schedule_execution)

on_reject.description: What a rejection of this handoff does (workflow-policy.yaml#handoff_rejection; validator W17): producer_retry re-runs the producer step with the rejection codes and a new revision, bounded by max_rounds (<= handoff_rejection.max_rounds_cap; rounds of every handoff naming the same producer share its max_attempts_per_step, so 1 + max_rounds <= max_attempts_per_step); escalate blocks the run with a blocker for escalate_to, a principal in may_cancel or may_start that can act; end_run ends the run failed with the rejection reason and is allowed only when no earlier step had an external effect or started children; compensate_then_end runs continuation.compensation first, keeps the run's locks until every compensation command is terminal with remote evidence, then ends the run failed. overrides send listed codes to another route; security codes end the run and notify the owner.

producer_step.description: Step that produces the corrected revision: this step (default) or an upstream step

max_rounds.description: Resubmissions after rejections (the first submission is round 1)

escalate_to.description: A roles.yaml role or assignment, a workflow-policy.yaml#human_aliases name or an agent id

producer_step.description: For a producer_retry override: the upstream step that re-runs for these codes (for example the input snapshot for stale_input); it shares the handoff's max_rounds

notify.description: Human role that receives a blocker notice with the code when this override ends the run (security codes: owner)

approval.description: Human decision for this step: one policy action, or one per cause when the authorized action depends on the case (each case names its own action and preconditions).

policy_action.description: Key in approval-policy.yaml actions or evolution-policy.yaml gates

policy_actions.description: Ordered human decisions required for this cause; each is a key in approval-policy.yaml actions

approved_in.description: The approval of these command actions is taken in this owner workflow's human approval step (workflow-policy.yaml#dispatch_ownership); this step records the cause and does not approve or dispatch the action itself (validator W11)

approvers.description: Narrows approval-policy.yaml actions.<action>.approvers for this case (never widens); the gateway routes the item only to these roles (validator W11)

approved_case.description: The cause of the case in the approved_in workflow's human approval step that takes this decision; that case must be at least as strict (never_auto, approvers) as this one (validator W11)

acks.description: Human ACKs this step must collect before it completes (DATA_MODEL handback_acks): one accepted row per active trigger, by a person on the pipeline's handback roster; an alert alone never completes the step (FR-GOV-10, ✅ Q31; validator W15)

by.description: Roster readiness key whose persons may ACK (ops.ads_handback_roster, ops.sale_handback_roster)

command_action.description: Canonical command action_type when this step dispatches through the command ledger

timeout.description: ISO-8601 duration, readiness:<key>, or input:<field> (bound approved in the run input)

on_timeout.description: What the step's timeout means for the run (human steps; validator W20). wait_and_escalate keeps the step open while limits.escalation runs, so a deputy or owner who acts later still completes it; fail_step_safe ends the step in the stated safe state; expire_item_and_close expires the pending item; auto_not_applicable records not_applicable

completes_on.description: Signal kinds that complete a human task step that has no approval block (each in continuation.signals and signals.catalog); a completing signal may not come only from a step that waits for this one (validator W21)

command_actions.description: Every command action_type this step may dispatch; the gateway sets the actual action_type per command and routes each to its own approvers (owner-only actions stay owner-only)

serves_cases.description: For a command action whose dispatch is split by case (workflow-policy.yaml#dispatch_ownership.actions.<action>.cases or .case), the case this dispatch step serves (validator W11)

emits.description: Signal kinds this step produces (workflow-policy.yaml#signals.catalog lists the step as a producer; validator W10)

starts.description: Child workflow runs this step starts through amt-workflow on behalf of the run (parent_run_id and parent step recorded). The child lists this workflow in trigger.parent_workflows, has parent_run in trigger.kinds and amt-workflow in authorization.may_start; input names every required field of the child; await child_completed needs child_run_completed in continuation.signals (validator W13)

key.description: Child correlation or dedup key value taken from this step's output

input.description: Child input fields this step supplies (all of the child's input.required_fields)

await.description: none: the parent step does not wait; started: it completes when each child run is created, and a refused start blocks the step with a blocker (never counts as done); child_completed: it waits for child_run_completed

condition.description: When a child is started (text over this step's outputs); absent means for every item the outputs name

on_parent_end.description: What amt-workflow does with this child when the parent run is cancelled, fails or is killed (workflow-policy.yaml#child_lifecycle): cancel_open cancels a child that has no external effect yet; continue leaves it under its own rules

input_values.description: Fixed child input values this start sets (for example round: experiment:<experiment_id>)

decision_rule.description: Shared statistical decision rule id this step applies (decision-statistics.yaml#decision_rules, validator K04)

step.description: Upstream step (in the transitive depends_on of this step)

output.description: Named output of that step: cause (one of its approval.by_cause causes), severity (operations.yaml#severities) or a field the step declares in its outputs text

condition.description: One condition on an upstream step's named output (validator W15)
